Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The mePROD method is a specialized hybrid of SILAC and TMT. It requires a specific processing step involving a 'booster channel' (fully SILAC labeled) and a 'noise channel' (non-SILAC labeled) for baseline subtraction and signal amplification of nascent chains, making standard bottom-up pipelines insufficient without custom logic for the booster/noise channel ratios.
